rewrites.//: The session cookie is Secure + SameSite=Strict. A strict cookie is never sent on a cross-site request, and regal-admin-panel.vercel.app / ondigitalocean.app are different sites — calling the API directly from the browser would drop auth on every request. Proxying it through this domain makes the browser see a same-origin call, exactly as the vite proxy does in development. This rule must stay ABOVE the SPA fallback.
SPA fallback: every other path renders the client-side router.

headers.//: Admin routes are never indexed and must not be cached (§21 Security).
